In a test, each student receives a score between $40$ and $100$. The table below shows the score distribution for the $13$ students in Class $A$ and the $11$ students in Class $B$.

| Score | Class $A$ | Class $B$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| $40$ | $0$ | $0$ |
| $50$ | $1$ | $0$ |
| $55$ | $1$ | $1$ |
| $60$ | $2$ | $1$ |
| $65$ | $2$ | $1$ |
| $70$ | $2$ | $2$ |
| $75$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| $80$ | $1$ | $1$ |
| $90$ | $1$ | $1$ |
| $100$ | $1$ | $1$ |
| Total | $13$ | $11$ |

The median score for Class $B$ is how many points greater than the median score for Class $A$?

The median score for Class $B$ is
{{field-1}}
point(s) greater than that of Class $A$.
